# discord_sticker_collection (Resource)

Manages an ordered collection of guild stickers. Uploads and verifies each entry sequentially in block order. Only recorded IDs are deleted. Do not also manage those IDs with individual resources. Discord does not expose picker positions or remote image hashes. Independent collections can run concurrently; use one collection per expression type or explicit depends_on. Import format: server_id:key=id,key=id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_sticker_collection" "star" {
  server_id         = var.server_id
  rebuild_on_change = true

  # File content changes are detected even when these paths stay the same.
  sticker {
    key         = "welcome"
    name        = "Welcome Templar"
    description = "Welcome to the clan"
    tags        = "👋"
    file        = "${path.module}/stickers/welcome.png"
  }

  sticker {
    key         = "ready"
    name        = "Ready"
    description = "Ready for battle"
    tags        = "✅"
    file        = "${path.module}/stickers/ready.png"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) Guild ID. Changing it replaces the collection.

### Optional

- `rebuild_on_change` (Boolean) Explicitly permit deleting ALL managed entries before sequential recreation when entries, order, artwork, or observed metadata change. Default false refuses such changes. IDs change, existing references may become invalid, and rate limits may make the collection unavailable for an extended period. Never use create_before_destroy.
- `sticker` (Block List) Entries in upload order. All existing managed entries are deleted before any replacement is uploaded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--sticker))

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Hash of ordered configuration and local artwork. Cleared on observed drift or partial failure so a subsequent plan repairs the collection.
- `id` (String) Collection identifier (server ID and expression type).
- `ids` (Map of String) Discord IDs indexed by stable entry key. Partial failures retain successful uploads for cleanup on the next apply.

<a id="nestedblock--sticker"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sticker`

Required:

- `file` (String) Path to a PNG, APNG, GIF, or Lottie JSON file, up to 512 KiB. File contents are fingerprinted at plan and apply.
- `key` (String) Unique stable key used in the ids map. Changing it rebuilds the collection.
- `name` (String) Discord expression name.
- `tags` (String) Sticker suggestion tags, up to 200 characters.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Empty or 2-100 character sticker description.
